justifications.r1: Colorless ramp, Eldrazi scions/spawns, and green land ramp into big mana.
justifications.r2: Eldrazi cast triggers draw massive hands (Kozilek, Zhulodok, Echoes of Eternity).
justifications.a1: Eldrazi tutoring and big spell redundancy.
justifications.a2: Deploys Ulalek and copies Eldrazi spells on Turns 5–6.
justifications.p1: Presents copied Annihilator Eldrazi titans on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: 1 opponent untap step or immediate lethal copied Eldrazi cast triggers.
justifications.p3: Cast triggers resolve even if Eldrazi are countered.
justifications.i1: All Is Dust and cast-trigger exile.
justifications.i2: Annihilator triggers force opponents to sacrifice boards.
justifications.s1: Eldrazi cast triggers cannot be answered by traditional counterspells.
justifications.s3: Big Eldrazi can win on their own without Ulalek.
